title: PlanEvent
description: One SSE event on GET /api/v1/plans/{id}/events. Section events carry the plan as it stands after that section. section 'plan' with state done or failed ends the stream.

plan.description: The plan as it stands after this event: a Plan (plan.schema.json), sections not finished yet absent. Typed as an object here because the Python generator cannot follow a reference into another file; agents-python and the gateway validate it as a Plan.
